background_image_description: All-over subtle paper-like speckled texture on a light beige background, with small irregular flecks and scratches in slightly darker beige tones (#D8CFB8, #CFC4A6) distributed uniformly across the 1600x1200 canvas.

nodes.asset_description: Retro cartoon character on the right: a large yellow smiley-face head (#F4C237) outlined with dark green (#174D3C), with two vertical dark green oval eyes featuring large white highlights, thin arched eyebrows, a small curved smile, and a red-orange oval nose (#D96049). The character has dark green noodle-like arms and legs, white gloves with green outlines and creases, bulky dark green shoes with white soles, and an oval dark green ground shadow beneath the feet. Style is 1950s rubber-hose animation with simple highlights and a few curved accent lines on the head.
